_note: Single source of truth for the storyboard, voiceover, captions and the Remotion project. README tables, SRT and word counts are generated from this by build-readme.mjs. Times are seconds.

scenes.name: Hook
scenes.visual: Warm paper background. Big serif headline types on. A phone floats up from below with the Home screen.
scenes.motion: Headline word-by-word reveal (0-3s). Phone rises with a soft shadow and a 3-degree tilt that settles flat (3-6s). Slow push-in on the greeting.
text: Two minutes. That's all it takes.
scenes.vo: You pick up your phone a hundred times a day. What if just two of those minutes made you sharper — and even paid you back?
scenes.sfx: Soft whoosh on phone rise; a single warm chime on 'paid you back'.

scenes.name: Meet Curi
scenes.visual: Curi wordmark and app icon centre-stage, then the otter pops in beside the phone with a speech bubble.
scenes.motion: Logo scales in with a gentle overshoot. Landing hero slides in from the right; zoom to the headline. Otter bounce-in with a wave.
text: One word. One fact. Every day.
scenes.vo: Meet Curi. One new word and one fact, every day. Two minutes, no pressure — with an otter cheering you on.
scenes.sfx: Pop on the logo; a friendly 'boing' when the otter lands.

scenes.name: Home & daily habit
scenes.visual: Home screen. Callouts highlight the streak flame, the daily checklist, and the prize banner.
scenes.motion: Phone centred; ring highlight pulses on the streak chip, then the checklist (words, fact, quiz). Scroll the Home screen down to the prize banner (use the two screenshots as a tall stitched scroll).
scenes.vo: Open the app and your day is ready: today's words, a quick fact and a short quiz. About five minutes.
scenes.sfx: Light tick as each checklist item is highlighted.

scenes.name: Learn & Play
scenes.visual: Rapid, clean sequence of four phones: word card, fact card, saved words (spaced review), then the Play tab and a daily-challenge question.
scenes.motion: Cards slide in from alternating sides with 0.3s overlap. Zoom to the word 'Resilient' and its example sentence; zoom to the 'Mastered / Learning' tags; end on the Play hub with a highlight on Word Duel.
scenes.vo: Hear each word, see it in a sentence, make it yours. Old words return at just the right moment, so they stick. Then play: a daily challenge, or a live Word Duel against a friend.
scenes.sfx: Card swish per slide; soft click on the highlighted tags; a quick game-start sting on the Play hub.

scenes.name: XP, levels & streaks
scenes.visual: Progress screen (streak, shields, weekly ring) then the profile with level bar and the pebble shelf of badges.
scenes.motion: Weekly ring animates to fill (re-create in motion graphics from the screenshot). Counter ticks up on XP. Badges pop onto the shelf one by one.
scenes.vo: Everything you do earns XP. Level up, collect badges, and keep your streak alive — shields cover you on busy days.
scenes.sfx: Rising tick for XP counter; small 'ding' per badge; whoosh on the streak flame.

scenes.name: Friends
scenes.visual: Friends screen: the weekly friends board and the streak-buddy card.
scenes.motion: Phone slides to the left third; callout lines draw to 'This week' board and 'Streak buddies'. Gentle highlight on your row.
scenes.vo: Add friends with a code and see who's winning this week. Even keep a streak together with a buddy.
scenes.sfx: Two soft pops as callouts appear.

scenes.name: Global leaderboard
scenes.visual: The global leaderboard: podium, countdown, ranked list, 'Your rank' bar; then the toggle to All-time.
scenes.motion: Zoom to the podium; pan to the countdown; scroll the ranked list so the highlighted 'You' row and the sticky 'Your rank' bar slide in; cross-fade to All-time.
scenes.vo: Then take on everyone. The global leaderboard ranks every learner, weekly or all-time, with a live countdown and your rank always in view.
scenes.sfx: Rank-up 'whoosh' as the list scrolls; soft tick on the toggle.

scenes.name: Weekly prizes (emotional high point)
scenes.visual: Dark 'night' scene. The podium rises, then the three prize amounts light up in turn. Calendar tile shows Monday.
scenes.motion: Podium blocks rise 2nd, 3rd, then 1st. Amounts count up: ₦1,000 then ₦1,500 then ₦2,500 (gold glow on first place). Confetti burst on N2,500. End with a Monday calendar flip and the line 'Resets every Monday'. Do NOT show 'winner' names or payouts as if they have happened.
scenes.vo: And every week, the top three win real cash. ₦2,500 for first. ₦1,500 for second. ₦1,000 for third. The board resets every Monday, starting Monday the sixteenth of November — so everyone gets a fresh start.
scenes.sfx: Deep riser into the podium rise; coin/shimmer on each amount; celebratory hit and confetti pop on ₦2,500; a calendar 'flip' on Monday. Music swells here, then settles.

scenes.name: Mascot moments
scenes.visual: Playful grid/carousel of the six mascot banner crops, each with its speech bubble. Use the phone clip of the mascot animating here if available.
scenes.motion: Six crops pop in with a springy stagger, then the best one (spin) scales up. The tone here is fun: bouncier easing, small confetti, sticker-like outlines.
scenes.vo: And Curi is always there: celebrating your wins, nudging you back, and making learning fun.
scenes.sfx: Boing, giggle-style pops, a cheer sting. Keep them short and quiet under the voice.

scenes.name: How it works
scenes.visual: Four-step horizontal timeline on paper background with icons: Sign up, Learn & earn XP, Play & climb, Win weekly prizes.
scenes.motion: Line draws left to right; each step icon pops in on the beat as the VO names it; the last step glows gold.
scenes.vo: Sign up. Learn and earn XP. Play and climb the ranks. Win weekly prizes. It really is that simple.
scenes.sfx: Four rising notes, one per step.

scenes.name: Closing CTA
scenes.visual: Logo lock-up with the otter waving, the URL, and a 'Get started: it's free' button.
scenes.motion: Everything settles to a calm hold. Button gently pulses once. Fade to the paper colour.
text: One word. One fact. Every day.
scenes.vo: Curi. One word. One fact. Every day. Start free at trycuri dot app.
